name: coordination/refusal-consent-spent
description: The one-shot refusal (ADR-0016 threat table, "replays a spent receipt"). A consent receipt that already dispatched cannot dispatch again under a different execution key. The refusal is `409`, not `403`: the caller was allowed to ask, and the authority is simply gone. It comes from the durable `uses` column plus a UNIQUE constraint on the dispatch ledger, so a daemon restart does not forgive it.

problem.title: that consent receipt has already been dispatched; consent is one-shot
